titulo: Vitachy Amber Glass Sprayer 500ml x2 Silicone Base Black-Chocolate
bullets: Contents: 2 x 500 ml amber glass sprayers with removable silicone base and pump with 2 spray modes and closure. Chalkboard labels and marker.
USES: Suitable for spraying any type of liquid based on water or oil. Useful for cleaning, gardening, ironing, hairdressing, pet care, etc.
2 spray modes: rotating the nozzle changes the spray mode: concentrate or diffuse atomization. A third mode closes the passage.
RESISTANT: Its silicone base prevents impact breakage and accidental drops due to its great adhesion to surfaces, even wet.
NO DRIPS: Unlike other glass sprayers, the head has a gasket that fits perfectly into the neck of the bottle, preventing any kind of dripping.
PRESENTATION: The product is delivered in a box with the sprayers protected by a bubble bag.
descripcion_html:
2 x 500 ml Glass Sprayers with removable silicone base and pump with 2 spray modes.

Applicable scene:

  • Ideal for spraying any type of water or oil based liquid.
  • Perfect for grooming, cleaning, gardening and pet care.

2 Spray Modes: By rotating the spray nozzle, you can switch between concentrated or diffuse atomization mode, adapting to your specific needs.

DURABLE: Its silicone base provides great adhesion to surfaces, even wet, preventing impact breaks and accidental drops.

Does not leak: Unlike other glass sprayers, the head has a gasket that fits perfectly into the neck of the bottle, preventing any kind of dripping.

Presentation: The product arrives in an elegant box with the sprayers in a bubble bag for optimal protection during transport.

STYLISH AND FUNCTIONAL - In addition to their practicality, these sprayers add a touch of sophistication to any workspace or home.
